title: Successor modulo three
statement: For every natural number $j$, advancing the phase represented by the remainder of $j$ modulo $3$ gives the phase represented by the remainder of $j+1$ modulo $3$.
replaced:
For every $j \in \bbn$, the cyclic successor on $\{0,1,2\}$ of $j \bmod 3$ is
$(j+1) \bmod 3$.  Hence the finite allocation phase is the remainder modulo three of
the number of guide cells already written.
